description: NaMn₂FeAg(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.27 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.33 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.31 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Ag sites. In the first Ag site, Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.60 Å) and two longer (2.61 Å) Ag-O bond lengths. In the second Ag site, Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.70 Å) Ag-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-66°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.59 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-58°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-62°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mn, one Fe, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mn, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mn and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mn, one Fe, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Mn and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mn, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mn, two Ag, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Fe, two Ag, and one P atom.
